answer_1.quote: We use four datasets, each curated to evaluate different aspects of alignment: 1. The GSM dataset ... to analyze reasoning ability. 2. The Toxigen dataset ... focusing on evaluating the model's ability to avoid generating toxic content. 3. ... Advbench ... to assess safety. 4. ... TruthfulQA ... to assess factual responses.

answer_2.quote: We employ the toxicity classifier based on roberta-large ... we report accuracy (ACC) to evaluate GSM performance. We also use two open-source finetuned LLaMA 12 to evaluate the truthfulness and informativeness of the model responses, reporting the percentage of responses that are both truthful and informative (% Info + True).

answer_3.quote: we employ GPT to assess the harmfulness of model responses on a scale of 1-5 (where a higher score indicates greater harmfulness)
